newsitem.title: USA: Pennsylvania revenues $573 mln above forecast.
newsitem.headline: Pennsylvania revenues $573 mln above forecast.

text.p: Pennsylvania has collected $15.7 billion of revenues so far this fiscal year, a figure $573 million more than analysts had projected, the state's Department of Revenue said.
May collections of $1.2 billion were $49 million, or 4.1 percent, above the official estimate.
Year-to-date collections of $1.5 bllion for the motor vehicle license fund were above estimate by $46 million. In May alone, the fund collected $11.7 million more than expected.
Corporation taxes are $72 million, or 2.1 percent, over estimate for the fiscal year, which ends June 30.
